description: Recover supported SQL from legacy procedural PHP and generate SQLAlchemy data-access artifacts and migration reports.

requirements: Python environment with C3 dependencies installed
C3 src directory available on PYTHONPATH

primary_outputs_note: The three outputs defined by the proposal. All other files in 'outputs' are supporting artifacts (reports and metadata).

outputs.migration_notes.md: Schema features not migrated automatically (unsupported column types, tables without a primary key)
outputs.security_report.json: Per-query user-input taint (legacy), sanitizers, generated handling (bound / schema-allowlisted), injection-safety coverage and generated-code scan
outputs.traceability_report.json: Per execution point: PHP file/line, recovery, column use, conversion status/rule, generated function or unresolved stub, cross-file construction site, action

limitations: Only supported SQL patterns are converted; others are reported as UNRESOLVED with file, line and reason
Static INNER JOIN SELECTs are supported; LEFT/RIGHT and dynamic JOINs are not
Generated data access uses SQLAlchemy text() with bind parameters, not ORM query constructs
An existing database schema must be supplied
